definitions.explanation: In a separate or individual manner; not together.

examples.japanese: {別々|べつべつ}に⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}に⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}に⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
{別々|べつべつ}に is the adverbial form of the na-adjective ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧, meaning to do something separately or individually rather than together.

FORMS:
- {別々|べつべつ}な / ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: separate (as modifier)
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: separate, different (single form, broader meaning)
- {別々|べつべつ}だ: to be separate (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別々|べつべつ}に⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay separately
- {別々|べつべつ}に⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live separately
- {別々|べつべつ}に⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act independently
- ⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go separate ways

USEFUL PHRASE:
⟦お{会計|かいけい}→お会計：09550_okaikei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{別々|べつべつ}にお{願|ねが}いします means "Separate checks, please" — a practical phrase for dining out in Japan.
